data.name: Challenger X
data.detailed_description:
CHALLENGER X: CAR DRIVING GAME

Get ready for the ultimate car driving adventure in ChallengerX: Car Driving Game by OXS Games, part of the Speedverse universe! Explore a massive open world, customize your rides, and compete in thrilling racing and drifting events designed for every car enthusiast.

WHAT MAKES CHALLENGER X UNIQUE?

Drift & Dominate: Show off your drifting skills and climb the leaderboards.

Race to Win: Compete in intense racing events, from speed challenges to drag races.

Ultimate Car Driving: Cruise freely or engage in non-stop competitive events.

Customize Your Ride: Add stickers, colors, and more for a personalized drift car.

Drag & Destroy: Test your limits in destruction challenges and claim victory.

Get ready for the ultimate open world racing experience! Explore a big city, drift through the streets, and feel the thrill of high-speed races. The new original map is here with amazing cars, better driving physics, and epic night mode! Crash, drift, and race your way to the top. Download now and join the action!

EVENT HIGHLIGHTS:

The fastest racer wins the crown.

Most stylish drift drivers take the glory.

Longest airtime gets the reward.

The ultimate destroyer dominates the field.

Exciting head-to-head drag races.

ChallengerX offers realistic car driving physics, stunning graphics, and endless fun for kids and car lovers alike. Drive through the open world, take on challenges, or just enjoy the thrill of the ride!

Note: Cars in the game may resemble popular models but are uniquely designed for ChallengerX.

Download now and experience the thrill of drifting, racing, and driving like never before!

*NOTE*

We do not have A3, A7, Mustang, Ranger, Evoque, Huracan licenses. The cars may contain similarities to real-life models of brands, but they do not belong to any particular brand.

In our game, we offer exciting racing experiences with alternative versions of popular car brands and models such as Ferrari 488, Lamborghini Aventador, Porsche 911, BMW M3, Mercedes-Benz S-Class, Audi R8, Ford Mustang GT, Chevrolet Camaro SS, Nissan GT-R, Bugatti Chiron, McLaren 720S, Aston Martin DB11, Jaguar F-Type, Tesla Model S, Volkswagen Golf GTI, and Toyota Supra, featuring similar designs and characteristics. Please note that we use these variations to provide an immersive and enjoyable gaming experience while respecting the original brands and models.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:

  • OS: Windows 10, 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti / AMD Radeon R7 260X
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Dahili Ses Kartı

  • DirectX: Version 11
